ops.text: The install worked. Next I write the reproduction test, before the fix, to see whether it actually fails.

ops: For the repro, I'm starting a background run that launches a long-running shell command, waiting for a marker file to confirm it started, then aborting the root conversation and checking the run rejects properly—watching whether abort actually kills the child process or lets it keep printing afterward, since that determines if the bug reproduces at all.
